TC-14/S26.title: Slow and failed generation while the physician is away: a generating state while the call runs, the note or an explicit failure on return (both modes)
TC-14/S26.detail: PW, local stack, both modes, generateNote mocked at the socket. Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run. Cell H (call held 15 s; the physician opens the second patient at once and comes straight back, ~0.95 s after the press): FAILED in both modes — while the call was still held Post-Round showed 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' (Hospital also the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button, B27) and no generating state; 5 s after the release the note (129/73, 121/67) was there (passed). Cell F (Regenerate with new dictation fails 3 s after it is asked while the physician is away; back after 30 s): FAILED in both modes — no failure message anywhere (Post-Round or Encounter tab); Post-Round shows the earlier note as the current note while the stored encounter text is the new dictation (125/75, 119/65); the dictation is kept on the Encounter tab (passed). Judged 8/12 per mode pair (h1 and f1 fail in each mode). On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). The failure message lives in the Encounter tab's component state and is lost when the chart is left. Dev confirmation of cell H: runs/2026-10-14-dev/newspec-c/results.gen.json TC-14/S26.
TC-14/S26.productIssue: After leaving a chart mid-Generate, Post-Round never shows that a note is being written ('No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.'), and when the generation fails while the physician is on another patient nothing says so: the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's although the new dictation was never turned into a note.
